disclaimer: Evidence only — not a verdict. This check cannot prove an agent never read outside its kit; it only surfaces file changes and content that matches material the arm was never given. Matches are flags for human review, not proof of a protocol breach.

writes_outside_src.note: Prompt asks the agent to implement in src/lib.rs (+ modules). Paths here are worth surfacing; cargo.lock / extra docs are common and not by themselves a protocol breach.
